evidence.limits: whisper.srt missing at coding time. Speech coded from frames: he never visibly speaks (headphones on, exercising, face mostly turned or strained), so the Reel is coded as text over a workout with licensed music; sound content not verified by ear or transcript. music field comes from dossier audio_type only. Only 3 screens of text exist, all static, so nothing was missed by 1 fps sampling. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Three-part warning: he told followers not to take the Covid vaccine (2020) and not to get a degree (2022), and now says most will be laid off because of AI except business owners (2025).
audience: Salaried employees and degree holders in Israel, his followers who 'didn't listen'; pushes them toward owning a business.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption ('ראו הוזהרתם בפעם ה-3') matches the text card; the video itself is a gym pull-up set with static text boxes, not a talking head. The caption adds a self-aware note that most viewers will not act and that the Reel is for his future archive.

opening.first_frame: Matan in a gym, bent forward over a step platform with a weight plate, headphones and cap, white tank top. Three white rounded text boxes already fully on screen in the lower half.
opening.s0_1: All three text boxes are visible from frame 0 (no build-in). He lifts and stands up from the plate; no cut.
opening.s1_3: He steps onto the platform, swings his arms and jumps up to grab a red pull-up bar (arms up at 2.0 s).
opening.s3_5: He does a weighted pull-up (dip belt with chain and a plate, about 3.5 to 4.0 s), lowers to a hang by about 4.25 s.
opening.visual_hook: Gym action: a jump to a weighted pull-up bar in one continuous shot, with a dense three-line text block on top.
opening.text_hook: ב2020 אמרתי לכם לא להתחסן לקורונה! והיום אתם מתחרטים שלא הקשבתם לי
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: the first line names a year and a claim; it needs knowledge of Israeli Covid-era debate but is self-contained.
opening.works_without_sound: yes, the whole message is in the text; the sound adds nothing visible

visual.subject_placement: Centered; camera low and close under the bar so he fills the middle of the frame; his body rises toward the top as he pulls up.
visual.setting: Gym with red steel bar, bare warm bulbs, gym machines behind.
visual.lighting: Warm tungsten bulbs above, cooler blue gym light low; mixed, contrasty, with bulb flare near him.
visual.color_contrast: Warm orange ceiling and red bar against dark gym; white text boxes with red, green and black words stand out strongly.
visual.props_and_gestures: Headphones, cap, dip belt with chain and weight plate, step platform; jump then repeated weighted pull-ups. No gesturing at camera.
visual.persistent_branding: none seen (a small logo on his cap only)
visual.faces_blurred: no (a person is faintly visible in the gym background at 12 s to 13 s, not identifiable)
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 1 s bend over plate; 1 to 2.5 s jump to the bar; 2.5 to 14 s continuous weighted pull-ups and hangs in one shot, camera fixed low.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover is a mid-pull-up frame with the same three text boxes.
visual.ui_interference: The text block sits at about 55 to 82% of frame height, inside the bottom 35% overlay zone in part (third box at roughly 73 to 80%); likely overlapped by caption and buttons on Instagram.

editing.edit_function: No edits: one continuous take. The only addition is a static text overlay; all stimulation comes from the exercise movement.
pacing_changes: none: steady rep rhythm, no cuts
editing.ending: About 12 to 14 s: he hangs then pulls up again; the Reel stops mid-set with no card or closing line (frames show the same text unchanged).
editing.loop: partial: repeated pull-ups give a cyclic motion and the last frame is a pull like earlier ones, but no designed loop is evident.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the text is dense (about 35 words) for a 15 s Reel, so a viewer may need a second pass to read it; the rep motion is hypnotic.

sound.delivery: Loudness is steady at about -14 to -18 dB from 0 to 15 s with no pauses (one dip to -20.6 at about 9.5 s), then near silence only at the very end; consistent with continuous music or a track, not stop-start speech.
sound.music: likely (dossier audio_type licensed_music, 'People So Stupid' by Tom MacDonald; steady loudness throughout; the machine transcript prints only 'תודה רבה' over 0-15 s, a music-only sign)
sound.sync: No sync to cuts (none exist); text is static for the whole Reel.

text.colour_coding: Years in dark red, the key negation 'לא' in red, 'שרובכם תהיו מפוטרים עקב הAi' in red, 'בעל עסק יוכל לשרוד' in green; the rest black on white.
text.placement: Lower half, three stacked white rounded boxes, centered, about 55 to 82% down the frame.
text.style: Bold sans Hebrew, black text on white rounded boxes, red and green emphasis words; looks like Instagram story-style text labels.
text.density_and_read_time: About 35 words in three boxes shown at once from 0 s; roughly 8 to 10 s to read at a normal pace, so the viewer reads while he lifts.
text.language: Parallel structure repeated three times ('ב2020 אמרתי לכם...' / 'ב2022 אמרתי לכם...' / 'וב2025 אני אומר לכם...'); direct address; boastful 'I told you'; short quotes: 'והיום אתם מתחרטים שלא הקשבתם לי'.
text.caption_structure: First line 'ראו הוזהרתם בפעם ה-3' with warning emojis, then a parenthetical (נ.ב) saying most viewers will not act and that the Reel is for his archive, plus a hint he may 'save you a fourth time'. No hashtags, no CTA.
text.rtl_notes: Mixed Hebrew with digits and Latin 'Ai' renders as 'הAi' glued to the Hebrew article; years glued to the Hebrew prefix ('ב2020'). Rendering reads correctly.

story.setup: Two past 'predictions' he says came true (vaccine, degree).
story.stakes: Being laid off because of AI; only business owners are said to survive.
story.progression: Escalating list of three warnings across years, all visible at once.
story.payoff: Third warning stated as the point: most will be laid off, business owners survive. No evidence given in the Reel.
story.resolution: None; the claim is left open and the caption adds that he is doing it for the record.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the claim is delivered in the first second as text, but no reasons or evidence follow.
friction_points: t=0 to 5 s: three boxes shown at once, a lot to read while the picture also moves (interpretation)
t=5 to 15 s: nothing new on screen, only repeated reps (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: none; caption says most viewers will not act

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 37 comments, not representative. Many argue about vaccines and degrees ('התחסנתי, מה קרה לי?' has 33 likes), others criticise ('קשקוש מוחלט...' long reply) or mock the predictions ('מתן הנביא'); several ask 'כל עסק?' or where to start; some fire emojis. Categories are my judgement and some comments fit more than one.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Short reactions only: a laughing emoji and a fire emoji; he does not answer the arguments in the sample.

conversion.proof: Only his claim that earlier warnings were right.
conversion.cta_fits_content: n/a: no CTA; the caption admits it is for his archive.

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel; dossier pair is null)

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film or viral clips. Licensed music attributed by Instagram. A gym bystander is faintly visible in the background, not identifiable. Nothing minor. LumeBook could copy the text-over-activity format but would need music rights.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a bold, checkable-sounding claim fills the screen from frame 0 and the physical stunt (jump to weighted pull-ups) gives motion without any editing; the repeated 'I told you' pattern and contested topics (vaccines, degrees) invite arguments, which show up in the comment sample.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no payoff evidence and no CTA, so it works on tension alone, and the likes-to-comments ratio suggests it drew more debate than agreement.

standout_moments.what: All three text boxes are on screen from the first frame so the hook is already complete (interpretation: no wait for the claim).
He jumps from the platform to the bar in one uncut move, a physical hook under the text.
Weighted pull-up with belt and plate, a visible status and strength cue.
